subject: Implement caffeinate helper (runs while delegations active)
description:
Build `capo/ops/caffeinate.py` — runs `caffeinate -i` while any delegation is in `running` state to prevent the Mac mini from sleeping mid-delegation.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] When the first delegation enters `running`, spawn `caffeinate -i` as a child process.
- [ ] When the last `running` delegation reaches a terminal state, terminate the `caffeinate` child.
- [ ] Reference-counted: multiple concurrent delegations share one `caffeinate` process.
- [ ] Process supervised: if `caffeinate` dies, respawn while delegations are still running.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Capo restart while delegations running: on boot, recount and respawn `caffeinate`.
- [ ] User has `caffeinate` already running for their own reasons: spawn an additional one (safe; OS handles ref-counting).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: spawn delegation → `caffeinate` running; kill delegation → `caffeinate` terminated
• Integration: 3 concurrent delegations → exactly one `caffeinate` process

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 8.1, 9.5
